integrity: An explicit analytic proof and independently executable finite sanity checks are included; no external mathematical audit or complete publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional matrices, finite singular positive matrix measure with positive definite total mass; no semidefinite or infinite-dimensional boundary theory, no joint eigenvalue law, and no claim that generic Herglotz representation or scalar Boole results are new. Equivalent older matrix spectral averaging forms remain a risk.
title: A matrix Cauchy law for singular Herglotz boundary spectra
